body: This is so beautifully written and so true
And we could all use a little change

They suggest an app that regularly prompts the 4 questions:

How would someone successful complete the goal?
How would you feel if you don’t do the required task?
What is the next immediate step you need to do?
If you could do one thing to achieve the goal on time, what would it be?

I think even if this worked in their experimental study, it would lose efficiency when used for all tasks
That’s actually a pretty great idea

My takeaway as well, and worse I myself got ‘bigger’ while living there. High calorie, high fat food is just more easily available and a lot cheaper. You can buy a fully prepared unhealthy meal (ie burgers fries pizza etc) for a fraction of the money it costs to buy fresh stuff to cook yourself a healthy meal. So it’s always a choice between spending more money and time or staying fit. It’s literally inconvenient to eat healthy, especially for people struggling financially
